name: pump_surf_pipeline
summary: End-to-end pump.fun behavioral-classifier + surf-executor pipeline. Streams Solana RPC logs (pump_stream_ingest) → extracts per-wallet behavioral features over a sliding window (pump_feature_extractor) → assigns GMM cluster + bot signature (pump_gmm_classifier) → applies the XGB binary gate against the human-inflow tide (pump_xgboost_gate) → routes the surviving GateDecisions through the surf executor (pump_surf_executor, DRY-RUN by default). Every pass anchors a trace_crystal; the final wave_frame_json + decisions feed the Streamlit live panel, the Godot pump_surf.tscn dashboard, and the /dapp/pump_surf route. The bot_density / human_inflow split rides the emission layer as additive sub-layers, mirroring the realestate light_field convention.

passes._note: Subscribes to PUMP_RPC_WSS / pump.fun program logs. Writes ~/.cc/pump_stream/<ts>.jsonl. Bounded by duration_seconds OR max_events, whichever first.

Per-wallet sliding window. 10 features: tx_per_block, value_entropy, jito_bundle_ratio, buy_sell_balance, unique_mints_touched, benford_distance, funding_proximity, gas_distortion, tx_per_block_var, session_length_seconds.
Per-wallet GMM cluster id + posterior. The bot cluster signature is the highest-density mixture component on the bot manifold.
Binary bot/human + human_inflow tide gate. Emits GateDecision{wallet, bot_prob, human_inflow, open}. Three gates must align before the executor flips.

DRY-RUN by default. Even when live_trading_confirm=true upstream, executor still requires PUMP_LIVE=1 + --confirm + 3 gates open before any real order. Emits SurfOrder{mint, side, sol, dry_run, gates_open}.

streamlit._note: Live wave_frame_json panel + decisions table + executor status.

dapp_route._note: HTMX panel served from studio/dapp/server.py. Reads wave_frame_json + gate_decisions via SSE.

_notes: Five-pass surf pipeline. All passes ACTIVE — pump_stream_ingest / pump_feature_extractor / pump_gmm_classifier / pump_xgboost_gate / pump_surf_executor are all on disk under core/lib/. Emission layer carries the bot_density + human_inflow split as additive sub-layers (mirrors light_field convention from realestate_walkthrough_full.v0). Card is crystal-anchored at the tail — the final trace_crystal binds the wave_frame_json + gate_decisions + surf_orders into one verifiable run hash, matching the studio_runtime pattern. DRY-RUN is the only mode that emits real orders today; live trading still requires PUMP_LIVE=1 in env + --confirm at the executor + 3 gates open.
